summary: Stage 1 only planned; stage 2 created a venv, downloaded the MUSE vectors and ran the pipeline. It reproduced ES Original 3.6918, ES Shift Ori 0.3087, cos 0.3885 and Spearman 0.450, and honestly flagged the FR, p-value and word-similarity discrepancies. It surfaced several [R] blockers: the SVC rather than LDA, missing matrices, no French SemEval data, and the buggy PCA. It missed all the validity issues (p-value mechanism, circularity, the Hybrid/Shift identity, cue list) and made no false claims. Only two of the four translation directions were run, and it called EN→ES P@1 replicated at 0.27 off.
